```python
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The fill color is the most frequent row-wise majority color.
    row_majorities = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    base = Counter(row_majorities).most_common(1)[0][0]

    nonbase = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != base)
    sep = nonbase.most_common(1)[0][0]

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == base for v in grid[r]) < w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == base for r in range(h)) < h / 2]

    def marked(r, c):
        return grid[r][c] != base and grid[r][c] != sep

    rows = [r for r in rows if any(marked(r, c) for c in cols)]
    cols = [c for c in cols if any(marked(r, c) for r in rows)]
    rows = [r for r in rows if any(marked(r, c) for c in cols)]

    return [
        [
            grid[r1][c1]
            if grid[r1][c1] == grid[r1][c2] == grid[r2][c1] == grid[r2][c2]
            and marked(r1, c1)
            else base
            for c1, c2 in zip(cols, cols[1:])
        ]
        for r1, r2 in zip(rows, rows[1:])
    ]
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The large repeated tiles determine the background color.
    row_colors = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(row_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # The grid lines are the most frequent non-background color.
    line_color = Counter(
        value for row in grid for value in row if value != background
    ).most_common(1)[0][0]

    line_rows = [
        r for r in range(h)
        if sum(value == background for value in grid[r]) < w / 2
    ]
    line_cols = [
        c for c in range(w)
        if sum(grid[r][c] == background for r in range(h)) < h / 2
    ]

    def is_marker(r, c):
        return grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != line_color

    # Keep only grid lines with at least one marker intersection.
    rows = [r for r in line_rows if any(is_marker(r, c) for c in line_cols)]
    cols = [c for c in line_cols if any(is_marker(r, c) for r in rows)]
    rows = [r for r in rows if any(is_marker(r, c) for c in cols)]

    result = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        out_row = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2],
                       grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2]]
            if all(value == corners[0] for value in corners) and is_marker(r1, c1):
                out_row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                out_row.append(background)
        result.append(out_row)
    return result
```

```python
            else:
```

```python
    row_maj = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(row_maj).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Separator color is the most common color apart from the tile fill.
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != background)
    separator = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Rows and columns dominated by the separator form the lattice.
    rows = [r for r in range(h)
            if sum(v == background for v in grid[r]) < w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w)
            if sum(grid[r][c] == background for r in range(h)) < h / 2]

    def is_marker(r, c):
        return grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != separator

    # Discard lattice lines that have no marker at their intersections.
    rows = [r for r in rows if any(is_marker(r, c) for c in cols)]
    cols = [c for c in cols if any(is_marker(r, c) for r in rows)]
    rows = [r for r in rows if any(is_marker(r, c) for c in cols)]

                v == grid[r1][c2] == grid[r2][c1] == grid[r2][c2]):
                out_row.append(v)
```
